final_user_goal: Create a reproducible, PIT-safe AI-Core eligibility layer for the A-share official Mother Pool so technical signals can only become AI-theme candidates when issuer evidence independently establishes an AI business.
hard_constraints: Eligibility must be independent of price strength, technical factors, realized returns and later winners.
Official Mother Pool remains the U-layer membership authority.
Positive AI-Core eligibility requires issuer-level official disclosure evidence available before the signal date.
Current vendor industry/theme tags may never substitute for eligibility evidence.
Same-day disclosure is excluded unless an availability timestamp proves it was available before the signal cutoff.
Historical reconstructed evidence observed after its purported PIT date cannot be relabeled prospective.
Missing evidence means NOT_ESTABLISHED, not a claim that the issuer is definitively non-AI.
soft_constraints_removed: Download and parse 5221 full PDFs before any positive AI-Core classification is possible.
Produce a definitive negative AI/non-AI judgment for every issuer.
Require industry taxonomy to define AI-Core.
Treat generic AI adoption, R&D intention or market-trend language as an AI business.
Recover the missing historical AI-Core Evidence Constitution V1.2 body from its SHA256 reference.

architecture.Delete: Delete full-market PDF prefetch and definitive-negative classification as prerequisites.
architecture.Avoid: Do not infer AI-Core from sector labels, company names, keyword counts, technical strength or hindsight.
architecture.Absorb: Reuse V2.7.29 full-market official Primary Locator Inventory and V2.7.30 on-demand immutable official PDF materialization.
architecture.Substitute: Use positive-evidence qualification: proven issuers become ELIGIBLE_AI_CORE; all others remain NOT_ESTABLISHED unless an explicit exclusion state is evidenced.
architecture.Precompute_Reuse: Use cheap non-authoritative candidate hints only to prioritize which official filings are materialized; cache each official PDF once by content hash.
architecture.Optimize: Only optimize candidate discovery and text extraction after the semantic rule engine passes synthetic validation.

historical_v1_2_reference.policy: Do not claim exact restoration. V2.8.4 is a new explicitly versioned executable eligibility implementation consistent with surviving V2.8.0 hard constraints.
